candidate_tools.name: get_issue
candidate_tools.description: Get a single issue by its ID, for example TRK-117. Returns the title, status, assignee, body and full comment thread.

id.description: Exact issue ID, as in the id field of an issue (e.g. TRK-117). Matching is exact; an unknown ID returns an "Issue not found" error.

candidate_tools.name: list_issues
candidate_tools.description: List issues, optionally filtered by status and assignee. Use to browse or enumerate issues; use search_issues to find issues by text in the title or body, and get_issue for one known ID. Returns at most 50 issues unless limit is set. Comments are included by default; set include_comments to false for smaller responses.

include_comments.description: Whether to include each issue's comments. Defaults to true when omitted; set false to get summaries without comments and reduce response size.

candidate_tools.name: search_issues
candidate_tools.description: Search issues by case-insensitive text match on title or body. Use when you have keywords; use list_issues to filter by status or assignee, and get_issue for one known ID. Has no status, assignee or limit filter, and returns all matches. Comments are included by default; set include_comments to false for smaller responses.
